scripts.dev: npm run build --workspace @portal/shared && concurrently -k -n api,web "npm run dev --workspace @portal/api" "npm run dev --workspace @portal/web"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @portal/shared && npm run build --workspace @portal/api && npm run build --workspace @portal/web
scripts.test: npm run build --workspace @portal/shared && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace @portal/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
